metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing rainfall in Seattle between September-November for 2021 vs 2020 and 2019. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is a good choice for rainfall data 2. Define Seattle area (I'll use a point with buffer around Seattle coordinates) 3. Time periods: Sep 1 - Nov 30 for each year (2019, 2020, 2021) 4. Calculate total rainfall for each period and compare 5. Handle data quality issues Let me structure this: - Geometry: Seattle area (Point with buffer) - Data: CHIRPS daily precipitation - Time periods: Sep 1 - Nov 30 for each year - Calculate sum of precipitation for each period - Compare 2021 vs both 2020 and 2019 - Handle empty collections, no valid pixels, etc. CHIRPS collection: 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' Band: 'precipitation' ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Seattle const years = [2019, 2020, 2021]; // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing let results = {}; for (const year of years) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 8, 1); // September (0-indexed) const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 30); // November 30 const collection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterBounds(seattle) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const count = collection.size(); const countInfo = count.getInfo(); if (countInfo === 0) { console.log(`${year} Images: 0`); results[year] = null; continue; } // Calculate total rainfall const totalRainfall = collection.sum(); // Get statistics const stats = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: seattle, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const rainfall = stats.get('precipitation_sum'); const pixelCount = stats.get('precipitation_count'); const rainfallInfo = rainfall.getInfo(); const pixelCountInfo = pixelCount.getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${countInfo} (Pixels: ${pixelCountInfo}, Rainfall: ${rainfallInfo ? rainfallInfo.toFixed(1) : 'null'})`); if (pixelCountInfo === 0) { results[year] = null; } else { results[year] = rainfallInfo; } } // 3. Validation & Final Answer if (results[2019] === null || results[2020] === null || results[2021] === null) { if (results[2019] === null && results[2020] === null && results[2021] === null) { console.log("C1"); } else { console.log("C2"); } return; } if (results[2019] === undefined || results[2020] === undefined || results[2021] === undefined || isNaN(results[2019]) || isNaN(results[2020]) || isNaN(results[2021])) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if 2021 rainfall > 2020 AND 2021 > 2019 const comparison = results[2021] > results[2020] && results[2021] > results[2019]; console.log(`2019 Total: ${results[2019].toFixed(1)} mm`); console.log(`2020 Total: ${results[2020].toFixed(1)} mm`); console.log(`2021 Total: ${results[2021].toFixed(1)} mm`); console.log(`2021 > 2020: ${results[2021] > results[2020]}`); console.log(`2021 > 2019: ${results[2021] > results[2019]}`); if (comparison) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
